home.testimonio1: What helped most was being told what the trip did NOT include. I arrived knowing exactly what I'd spend.

home.confianzaTitulo: How to tell if an agency is trustworthy
home.confianzaTexto: Travel fraud is real in Colombia, and being wary is sensible. These are three things you can check in minutes, with us and with anyone.
home.check1: Ask for the National Tourism Registry number and look it up in the official registry.
home.check2: Insist on written confirmation, with dates, price and what's included.
home.check3: Be wary if you're asked to pay into a personal account rather than a business one.

nosotros.titulo: Two friends who became brothers, and a way
nosotros.entradilla: BroWay Adventures started from a friendship. Two people with the same habit: travelling, discovering, and helping others do it.
nosotros.historiaP1: The agency began the way lasting things begin: two friends planning trips, first their own and then everyone else's. Over the years that friendship became brotherhood, and what was a favour became a trade.
nosotros.historiaP2: That's where the name comes from. "Bro" is the bond, the person who goes with you and tells you the truth. "Way" is the road, the trip and also how you take it. Together they are what we try to be when someone writes to us: someone you can trust who already knows the route.
nosotros.proposito: Our purpose is to make travelling feel clearer, closer and more possible for more people. It sounds simple and it isn't: most people who don't travel aren't held back by wanting to, but by a process that looks confusing or untrustworthy.
nosotros.mision: Our mission is to guide and accompany travellers in Colombia as they choose domestic and international experiences, with complete information from the first message.
nosotros.vision: Our vision is to be a travel brand known in Colombia for the trust it earns, not the volume it moves.

comoPagar.titulo: How you pay for a trip with us
comoPagar.entradilla: No small print. This is everything that happens between choosing the trip and boarding the plane.
comoPagar.abonoTexto: To reserve your place you pay 30% of the total. That deposit confirms dates and rate, and from then on the trip is in your name.
comoPagar.saldoTexto: The balance is paid in instalments up to the departure date. How many and when is agreed with you when you book.
comoPagar.aclaracionTexto: We are not a financial institution and we do not grant credit. What we call instalments is an agreed payment schedule, not a loan or financing.
comoPagar.mediosPendiente: Accepted methods are pending confirmation. Your advisor tells you before any payment.
comoPagar.paso1: You get written confirmation, with the dates and what your trip includes.
comoPagar.paso2: Your advisor helps you with documents and anything you need to prepare.
comoPagar.paso3: Before departure you receive all the trip information, already settled.
comoPagar.seguridadTexto: Check its National Tourism Registry, ask for written confirmation, and be wary of anyone asking you to pay into a personal account. Apply this to us too.

faq.entradilla: The questions we get most. If yours isn't here, write to us and we'll answer it.
faq.p1: How do I book a trip?
faq.r1: You write to us on WhatsApp or leave your details in the form. An advisor puts together a quote with the full price, and if it works for you, you book with the 30% deposit.
faq.r2: That deposit holds your place and confirms the rate. The balance is paid in agreed instalments before departure. It isn't credit: it's a payment schedule.
faq.p3: What if I need to change the dates?
faq.r3: It depends on the trip's conditions and the operator. Each trip has its own change and cancellation policy, and your advisor explains it before you book.
faq.p4: How do I know the agency is legitimate?
faq.r4: Every travel agency in Colombia must hold a valid National Tourism Registry number, and you can look it up in the official registry. Ours is in the footer of this page. Check it.
faq.p5: What documents do I need to travel?
faq.r5: For domestic trips, your ID. For international ones it depends on the country, and requirements are set by each government. We confirm which apply to you before you buy.
faq.p6: What do you do with my personal data?
faq.r6: We use it to handle your request, quote, follow up and send you commercial information, always where you have authorised it. You can access, update and delete it, and withdraw your authorisation whenever you want.
